move: white icon morphs play, pause, heart, alert, star; blob background recolours
how: A dark card holds an SVG with a coloured blob and a white icon path, a name label under it and five pager dots. Every 0.2D (from 0.11D) the icon morphSVGs to the next shape over 0.55s (power3.inOut) while spinning 180 degrees and squeezing to scale 0.7 (power2.in) then back with back.out(3); the blob morphs to a new outline and fill colour over 0.6s, the name drops out (yPercent -110, power2.in), swaps in a callback and rises from 110 (expo.out), and the active dot moves. The blob rotates a full 360 over D (ease none). Five icons in 5s bring it back to Play.
adapt: Replace the ICONS paths, names and colours and the BG blob outlines; keep 0.55s morph, the 180-degree spin and the back.out(3) release; step = D / icon count.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the card, SVG and dots; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with at = i*(D/n) + 0.11D. Scope '#icon', '#bg', '#nm', '.dots i' to el.
caveats: name and dot changes happen in callbacks and do not reverse on backward scrub
the last transition ends ~5.2s, past D=5, so the loop point cuts the final morph short
fromTo tweens use immediateRender:false and must keep it
